an10.119:1.1: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo tadahuposathe sīsaṃnahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhito hoti.
an10.119:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahātaṃ navaṃ khoma yugaṃ nivatthaṃ allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ.
an10.119:2.3: kiṃ nu kho tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhito?
an10.119:3.1: yathākathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotī ti?
an10.119:3.2: idha bho gotama, brāhmaṇā tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahātā navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthā allena gomayena paṭhaviṃ opuñchitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca aggyāgāraṃ seyyaṃ kappenti.
an10.119:3.3: te taṃ rattiṃ tikkhattuṃ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṃ namassanti
an10.119:3.5: pahūtena ca sappitelena navanītena aggiṃ santappenti.
an10.119:3.6: tassā ca rattiyā accayena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena brāhmaṇe santappenti.
an10.119:3.7: evaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.119:4.1: aññathā kho brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī
an10.119:4.2: ti. yathākathaṃ pana bho gotama, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti?
an10.119:4.3: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.119:5.1: tena hi brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
an10.119:5.2: evaṃ bhoti kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi,
an10.119:15.5: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.119:16.1: aññathā bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.119:16.2: imissā ca kho bho gotama, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇiyā brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an10.119:16.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
